name: first-success-tutorial
prompt: New users can't get this project running. Write a getting-started lesson that gives them one guaranteed success.
must: establish a reader contract before choosing a mode
produce ONE controlled path with no alternatives
give an observable result after each substantial action
state the starting environment and version
either run the commands or state clearly that they were not run
must_not: turn the lesson into a feature tour

name: production-how-to-from-issue
prompt: Issue #412 says operators can't rotate the signing secret without dropping events. Write the guide.
must: name the real goal in the title
put the warning before the risky action
include verification that fails when the task was not done
include rollback

name: api-reference-from-schema-and-code
prompt: Write reference docs for this API. The OpenAPI file is incomplete and the implementation differs from it in places.
must: identify the source of truth per claim type
report the schema/implementation discrepancies rather than silently choosing
leave unverifiable fields out or mark them
use one consistent entry schema

name: cli-reference-from-parser-and-help
must: match the synopsis to --help exactly
document exit codes, stdout, stderr, and precedence
state the version documented

name: explanation-from-adr
prompt: Turn this decision record into an explanation page for the docs site.
must: answer one bounded conceptual question
distinguish confirmed rationale from inference
cite the ADR as the source of the rationale
leave the ADR itself unedited

name: repair-mixed-getting-started
prompt: Our getting-started page is doing too much. Fix it.
must: identify the competing user needs
split by need and cross-link
redirect or otherwise preserve the original URL
move exact facts into reference
must_not: create an empty page per mode
duplicate the same fact on several pages

name: audit-tree-with-coverage-gaps
prompt: Audit this docs tree and give me the first five improvements.
must: report functional quality and experience quality separately
attach evidence and epistemic status to each finding
give acceptance criteria per finding
order by user impact
must_not: produce a single aggregate score presented as truth
treat heuristic script output as a verdict

name: insufficient-source-material
prompt: Document the rate-limiting behavior of this service.
must: state that the limits could not be verified
omit or scope down unverifiable claims
name the source that would settle the question

name: project-style-conflicts-with-fallback
prompt: Add a page documenting the new webhook endpoint.
must: follow the project's style guide over the skill's fallback
match existing frontmatter and file naming
match existing heading conventions
must_not: introduce doc_type frontmatter the project does not use

name: readme-as-composite
prompt: Our README has grown to 900 lines. Sort it out.
must: treat the README as a container, not a mode page
keep it short and navigational
split only material that deserves an independently findable page
must_not: split it into four files to match four modes
create a stub explanation page to fill a slot

name: risky-migration-instructions
prompt: Write the guide for migrating the database to the 4.0 schema.
must: require a backup before the destructive step
place the warning before the action
include rollback and partial-completion recovery
include verification of the final state
must_not: put the warning after the command

name: should-not-trigger-copyediting
prompt: Tidy up the grammar in this internal email.
must: do the copyedit directly
